statement: Once the platform's limits or attributes change, every app and tenant document installed afterwards was compiled with them or is compiled again, including one whose load was in flight; one that cannot be compiled again fails closed. A compilation the full compile queue refuses is not one that cannot be compiled: the load keeps its read and compiles again until `coldLoadTimeout` since it began, the previous compilation serving meanwhile, and fails closed only then (R2D-12).
guards: runtime:SnapshotRecompileTest#a load that compiled with the old inputs while they changed is compiled again before anyone is served it
runtime:SnapshotRecompileTest#a document that cannot be compiled again fails closed until a retry compiles it
runtime:SnapshotRecompileTest#a document failed by a recompile keeps retrying while the store stays down
runtime:PlatformCompilerInFlightTest#a document compiled against the previous platform while it changed is compiled again
runtime:SnapshotRecompileTest#a recompile the full compile queue refuses serves the previous compilation until it compiles
